description: Runner reconnect reconciliation that preserves still-existing Runtime Sessions and settles AgentSession activity, plus binding-guarded cancel-settles-idle and typed SDK existence checks.

tasks.title: Route all physical-Session existence checks through the typed SDK contract and carry active-turn
tasks.description: Replace every untyped `as never` OpenCode SDK call (resolve at opencode/runtime.ts:134-137, followup resolve at :293-296, followup promptAsync at :313-319, cancel abort at :369-372) with the typed `{ sessionID, directory }` request contract that turn.ts already uses. Capture the active-turn snapshot: OpenCode via `session.status({ directory }, { throwOnError: true })`, Pi via the existing `isStreaming` getter on the cached session handle (pi/runtime.ts:83-96). Enrich `BindingProbeResult` in binding-recovery.ts to carry `activeTurn: boolean` on the present branch so callers distinguish present+idle from present+active. Only `kind === "missing-session"` still authorizes recovery; `present` (any activeTurn) preserves the binding.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero `as never` casts remain in opencode/runtime.ts existence/probe/promptAsync/abort call sites — verified by `npm run typecheck -w packages/runner` passing and a grep asserting no `as never` in those positions.
`BindingProbeResult` present branch carries `activeTurn: boolean`; binding-recovery.ts populates it from the runtime probe for both OpenCode (session.status) and Pi (isStreaming).

Unit tests verify the typed call shape is used (fake SDK asserts on the typed request object, not `as never`) and that `activeTurn` is correctly `true` for a streaming session and `false` for an idle session.
Existing resolve, followup, and cancel paths continue to pass their current unit tests with no behavioral regression.
tasks.output: Updated opencode/runtime.ts, pi/runtime.ts, and binding-recovery.ts with typed SDK calls and enriched BindingProbeResult; passing runner typecheck + unit tests.
tasks.notes: Design decision D6. Foundational refactor: the enriched active-turn probe is consumed by T-003 reconnect reconciliation. The cancel-abort call typing (opencode/runtime.ts:369-372) is included here so D6 is one coherent typed-contract migration, not split across tasks.

tasks.title: Cancel settles AgentSession activity to idle through the binding-guarded runtime-events outbox
tasks.description: Add `AgentSessionRuntimeEventOutbox` to `CancelHandlerDeps` (cancel-handler.ts:34-38). After `callCancel` returns, enqueue a binding-guarded `session.activity` fact through the durable outbox: `{ idle }` when the stop is confirmed (`facts.cancelled && facts.stopConfirmed`), or `{ unknown }` when the stop is unconfirmed. The existing grain `ApplyRuntimeEventToDomain` → `ParseActivity` path settles activity, and `AppendEventsAsync(..., requireCurrentRuntimeBinding: true)` automatically discards facts whose runtimeSessionId is no longer the current binding. The SignalR reply continues to surface `interruptUnconfirmed: true` for unconfirmed stops.
acceptanceCriteria: A confirmed Cancel against an `active` AgentSession transitions activity to `idle`; the next read through the normal API/CLI reports `idle` — verified by a spec test using injected fakes (no operator-written runtime event).
A confirmed Cancel against an `unknown` AgentSession (e.g. post-Runner-restart) whose stopped binding is still current settles activity to `idle` — verified by spec test.
An unconfirmed stop (`stopConfirmed === false`) enqueues `session.activity { unknown }` and surfaces `interruptUnconfirmed: true`; activity does NOT settle to `idle`.
A stop fact for a superseded binding is discarded by the binding guard; current binding, activity, transcript, and accumulated usage remain unchanged — verified by spec test.
Cancel does not create a candidate Session, replace the binding, or replay/re-submit input.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner` and runner unit tests pass.
tasks.output: Updated cancel-handler.ts with AgentSessionRuntimeEventOutbox in CancelHandlerDeps and the confirmed/unconfirmed activity-fact write; passing runner typecheck + unit/spec tests.
tasks.notes: Design decision D5. Independent of T-001: the cancel handler writes the outbox fact based on callCancel's reply, not on the existence probe. Touches cancel-handler.ts only (the cancel-abort call typing in opencode/runtime.ts belongs to T-001). OpenCode's stopConfirmed defaults to true (command-runtime.ts), so OpenCode cancels settle Idle; only Pi can produce a real unconfirmed stop.

tasks.title: Runner-reconnect reconciliation: preserve still-existing sessions, settle idle, recover confirmed-missing
tasks.description: Add `IAgentSessionStore.ListByRunnerForReconcileAsync(runnerId)` returning non-Idle sessions bound to the Runner (filtered on the durable `AgentSessionRow.RunnerId` column), and expose it via `GET /api/runner/{runnerId}/agent-sessions/reconcile` projected to `{ sessionId, runtime, runtimeSessionId, workDir }`. Add a Runner-side reconciliation pass to `onDispatchReconnected` (host.ts:350-362, parallel to the WorkflowRun convergence in cleanup-convergence.ts) that pulls this list, probes each binding via the typed active-turn probe from T-001, and reports results through existing channels: present + no active-turn → enqueue binding-guarded `session.activity { idle }` via AgentSessionRuntimeEventOutbox (existing grain ParseActivity settles Unknown/Active → Idle); present + active → enqueue `session.activity { active }`; confirmed-missing → create at most one empty candidate Session locally (reusing createEmptySession) and call a new `POST .../reconcile-missing` endpoint backed by `IAgentSessionGrain.ReconcileMissingBindingAsync(expected, replacement)` which settles Activity=Idle and calls RebindRuntimeSession atomically under one CAS; transient/transport/unavailable/corrupt → keep binding, leave `unknown`. No input is submitted on bare reconnect.
acceptanceCriteria: After Runner reconnect, a still-existing Session with no active turn keeps its current binding and settles to `idle`; the next task continues through the same binding with existing context — verified by spec test with injected fakes and no wall-clock timing.
A still-queryable Session is never classified as missing or replaced during reconnect — verified by spec test asserting no candidate creation and unchanged binding.

A confirmed-missing Session on reconnect creates at most one candidate, settles Idle + rebinds atomically under one CAS via ReconcileMissingBindingAsync; no input is submitted on bare reconnect — verified by spec test.
Repeated reconnect/retry attempts leave at most one candidate Session (a second reconnect probes the new binding → present → no second candidate) — verified by spec test.
Transient failure, transport failure, unavailable runtime, or corrupt response preserves the binding and leaves activity `unknown`; no recovery is authorized — verified by spec test.
A `present + activeTurn` result keeps the Session `active` (or promotes `unknown → active`); it is never classified as missing — verified by spec test.
A stale-binding reconciliation result (binding superseded by Reset or prior recovery) is ignored; current binding, activity, transcript, and accumulated usage are unchanged — verified by spec test.
The reconcile query filters on the durable `AgentSessionRow.RunnerId` column, not the in-memory RunnerConnectionTracker._sessions (which is empty after crash) — verified by unit test.
`npm test` (server, C#) and runner typecheck + tests pass.
tasks.output: Server: ListByRunnerForReconcileAsync store query + GET .../reconcile endpoint + ReconcileMissingBindingAsync grain method + POST .../reconcile-missing endpoint. Runner: binding-convergence pass in onDispatchReconnected. Passing server + runner tests.
tasks.notes: Design decisions D1 (Runner-driven reconcile via existing convergence loop), D2 (durable query over AgentSessionRow.RunnerId, not in-memory tracker), D3 (happy-path settles via existing session.activity channel — zero new grain transition logic), D4 (confirmed-missing settles idle + rebinds atomically; no input on bare reconnect), D7 (superseded-binding safety is automatic via existing CAS). Depends on T-001 for the enriched BindingProbeResult with activeTurn to distinguish present+idle from present+active.
